changed: Dances you import from The Caller's Box read four more kinds of line as figures instead of text: "Hey 1/8 (WR)" is the robins passing by the right shoulder; "As couples, neighbor do si do" is a neighbor do si do, noted as danced as couples; "Partner Jersey twirl" is a California twirl, noted as a Jersey twirl; and a double slice that goes forward to one neighbor and back to the next is a slice with a diagonal return. A figure you type as "As couples, neighbor do si do" or "Partner Jersey twirl" is read the same way.

The Caller's Box figure dialect reads `Hey 1/8 (<pair><side>)` as `pass_by`, `As couples, … do si do` as `do_si_do` with an `as couples` note, `… Jersey twirl` as `california_twirl` with a `Jersey twirl` note, and the adapter's double-slice fold accepts `N<k>` then `N<k+1>` as well as `S1` then `S2`.
